basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent high school graduate from Indiana, excited to start my journey at Purdue University this spring. I'm a huge fan of TV shows like 'House' and love playing shoot 'em up games in my free time. When I'm not binge-watching or gaming, you can find me listening to Florence and the Machine. I'm currently single and living in a dorm on campus. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after classes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong interest in entertainment media and video games, largely self-taught through personal exploration and online communities. My familiarity with Purdue University is growing as I participate in events like Boiler Cold Rush.
